facts.text: C101 (summer league) · Oaks · front-office · MIke Paulson (Head of Basketball Operations), Elliot Abraham (GM): After Mike Paulson shared who was his bridge and support in his lone year as Bulls GM last season was Elliot Abraham. Well today Paulson hired Elliot Abraham as the new GM of The Oaks. As Paulson stated last cycle without Elliot the 2 city task of Oakland and Chicago wouldnt have been a success. For Paulson to bring Elliot to Oakland to GM in the same city Paulson attempts the As GM and Oaks Head of Operations should help ease the minds of those who think Paulson will lose focus on As or not be involved enough for the Oaks. | Stats: - | Team record: - | Streak: -

Wilson Shepards also said Adash Stanley will participate and obviously #1 pick AJ Dybantsa. | Stats: - | Team record: 0-0 | Streak: -

Austin Reaves played with Lakers last season and figures to be a #1 option to start the season | Stats: - | Team record: - | Streak: -

In the 2nd rd with pick #5 Oaks draft Coen Carr | Stats: - | Team record: - | Streak: -

C99 (off-season) · Oaks · front-office · Elliot Abraham: Mike Paulson introduces his assistant that he says was his key to success in his dual role with As and Bulls last season. Elliot Abraham is said to double as Mike Paulson in is day to day | Stats: - | Team record: - | Streak: -

C99 (off-season) · Oaks · trade-recap · Herbert Jones (SF): Paulson makes his first major move trading the 5th pick in this years draft, a unprotected 1st Y5C1 and Herbert Jones, for the #1 pick in this year draft. Paulson trading a potentially valauble pick in 3 years to move up 5 spots to pick #1. Paulson banking on netting his star now | Stats: - | Team record: - | Streak: -

C99 (off-season) · Oaks · roster-move · Wendall Carter Jr (C), Donte DiVencenzo (PG), Draymond Green (C): The Oaks Expansion draft ended tonight with Oakland welcoming several new players. Remains unclear if these players will remain on the team as Paulson now begins to shape the roster with new coach Shepard. Rumors have been circulating on Oaks interest in Adash Stanley (PG), that played his rookie season in Chicago last season when Paulson was head of basketball operations for the Bulls. Paulson confirmed the interest in a brief interaction with press at the expansion draft. Paulson stated, "look we'd love to have Adash Stanley and Hank Trepagnier from last years squad"., Paulson went on" Trepagnier is happy in Chicago and looks to be getting paid, Chicago want Stanley to stay but Stanley is taking calls". Paulson also seem to suggest the veterans drafted tonight are great pieces. Draymond has a player option he can opt out of so that decision is with him. | Stats: - | Team record: - | Streak: -
